home.title: Hristo Karakerezov — UX/UI & AI Experience Designer
home.heroLine1: The best interfaces rarely ask for attention.
home.heroName: Hristo Karakerezov — UX/UI & AI Experience Designer
home.heroTagline: Clarity, aesthetics and intelligent workflows shaped into digital experiences.
home.workLead: Selected UX/UI and digital product work — from mobile apps and web platforms to interface systems shaped through research, structure and visual clarity.

home.aboutBody: With a long background in graphic, brand and print design, the work gradually evolved toward UX/UI, product interfaces and AI-assisted design workflows. The focus today is on creating digital experiences that feel clear, aesthetic and easy to understand.
home.archiveBody: A curated selection of earlier visual work — branding, packaging, print design, advertising and digital graphics.
